headline: Fuel prices hike: Fuel prices rise by 20 taka per litre
summary: Diesel, petrol, and octane prices increase starting Monday, following significant losses incurred by the Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation.
details: The prices of diesel, kerosene, petrol, and octane have increased by 20 taka per litre. Starting Monday, September 21, diesel will be sold at 135 taka, kerosene at 155 taka, petrol at 160 taka, and octane at 165 taka per litre.

headline: MP Gazi Nazrul's second wife found dead at NAM Bhaban flat
summary: The MP and his first wife have been taken into custody for questioning by police after the woman's body was found hanging in a flat in Sher-e-Bangla Nagar.
details: The body of Moshammat Mariyam Khatun, the second wife of Satkhira-4 MP Gazi Nazrul Islam, was recovered from a flat in the NAM Bhaban in Sher-e-Bangla Nagar, Dhaka.
Police received a report of a hanging body around 7 PM. Teams from the Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Police Station, CID, PBI, and DB were dispatched to the scene.
Investigation revealed that the flat in NAM Bhaban's Building 5, Room 203, belonged to the Member of Parliament.
MP Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife have been taken into custody by the police for questioning regarding the incident.
The body has been sent to Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital for an autopsy to determine the cause of death.

Gazi Nazrul Islam was elected as an MP from the Satkhira-4 constituency on a Jamaat-e-Islami ticket. He was later expelled from the party in July after a private video of him with a young woman surfaced online.
Following his expulsion, Jamaat-e-Islami wrote to the Speaker and the Election Commission to take necessary action against him.
caption:
An MP's second wife found dead in a Dhaka flat. The MP and his first wife are now in police custody.

The body of Moshammat Mariyam Khatun, the second wife of Satkhira-4 MP Gazi Nazrul Islam, was recovered from a flat in the NAM Bhaban in Sher-e-Bangla Nagar, Dhaka.

Police received a report of a hanging body around 7 PM. Teams from the Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Police Station, CID, PBI, and DB were dispatched to the scene.

Investigation revealed that the flat in NAM Bhaban's Building 5, Room 203, belonged to the Member of Parliament.

MP Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife have been taken into custody by the police for questioning regarding the incident.

The body has been sent to Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital for an autopsy to determine the cause of death.

Gazi Nazrul Islam was elected as an MP from the Satkhira-4 constituency on a Jamaat-e-Islami ticket. He was later expelled from the party in July after a private video of him with a young woman surfaced online.

Following his expulsion, Jamaat-e-Islami wrote to the Speaker and the Election Commission to take necessary action against him.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV, The Daily Star
